identity.name: AgriSmart
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix botanical aesthetics with precision data dashboards.
Emotion First: Farmers need trust and clarity. Design for confidence.
Content is King: Data is the story. Make it readable and actionable.
Zoom In: Focus on the details of the crop and the data point.
Negative Space: Don't clutter the dashboard. Let the data breathe.

headings.usage: All section headers, hero titles, card titles. DO NOT use Inter.

mono.usage: Sensor raw values, API keys, code snippets.

typography.installation: Import fonts in index.css via Google Fonts: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap');

colors.theme_strategy: Hybrid (Light Mode Default for Field Visibility, Dark Mode Toggle for Night Monitoring)

spacing.rule: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8.

landing_page.rules: Asymmetry is key. Use col-span-full for hero, col-span-4 for features. Never fill 100% perfectly.

dashboard.rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children. No jagged bottoms.

marketing_components.style: Glassmorphism or 'Tracing Beam' borders for feature cards.

dashboard_components.style: Neumorphism (Tactile) or Grid Borders (Technical). Clean, crisp edges.
dashboard_components.charts: Chart.js (via react-chartjs-2) wrapped in Shadcn Cards.

specific_overrides.buttons: Pill-shaped for marketing, slightly rounded (rounded-md) for dashboard controls.
specific_overrides.cards: Remove default shadows, use 1px borders with subtle colors. Add hover lift.
specific_overrides.inputs: Shadcn Input with 'h-12' for better touch targets on tablets.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain/noise overlay to the background to reduce 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with backdrop-saturate-150 for overlays and sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (default). Use stroke-width={1.5} for elegance.

hero_bg.alt: Smart irrigation sprinklers in a field
hero_bg.usage: Hero section background or main visual

farmer_tech.usage: Feature section or 'How it works' visual

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: Run 'npm install react-chartjs-2 chart.js framer-motion lucide-react' immediately.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css first.
3. THEME: Update tailwind.config.js with the specific color palette provided.
4. LAYOUT: Build the Landing Page using the 'Tetris Grid' and Dashboard using 'High Density Grid'.
5. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for complex interactions (Dialogs, Forms) but style them to match the 'Organic & Earthy' theme.
6. CHARTS: Implement the Commodity Price Prediction using Line Charts with confidence bands (filled area).
7. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Dark colors must be solid, not gradients.
